DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's syndrome secondary to chronic lung pathology (likely asthma or COPD exacerbation). 

Given your confirmed elevated urinary cortisol and the worsening of symptoms at night with exertion, I suspect your respiratory issues may be exacerbated by metabolic changes associated with Cushing's. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray to rule out opportunistic infections or other structural lung issues common in immunocompromised states.
